ADC_APEX_ACTION_TYPES

Table to store the allowed APEX action types.

Columns
caat_id

Primary key. One of the allowed APEX action types

caat_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

caat_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, Fixed value ADC

caat_active

Flag to indicate whether data is actually in use

References

caat_pti_id, caat_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg)
